dedupe_keys.name: dados dos indicadores de qualidade de energia da rede basica dfd desempenho da frequencia em disturbios por evento

description: ONS publishes event-level frequency-disturbance indicators. Fields identify the event start, entry and exit times for frequency bands, time spent in a band in seconds, and the minimum or maximum frequency in hertz. These observations support calibration or comparison of grid-disturbance models. They preserve individual events, unlike the separate monthly and rolling-year aggregates. Indicator definitions follow the provider reference to Submodule 9.7 of the Network Procedures. Coverage is frequency disturbances in the national basic grid in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
